headings.rationale: Gives a heavy-weight, industrial athletic feel suitable for a steel and roofing business. Replaces generic SaaS fonts with something commanding and raw.

body.rationale: High legibility for dense tables, forms, and analytical text.

data_numbers.rationale: CRITICAL for inventory and financial data (KG, amounts, GST) so decimals and units align perfectly vertically.

colors.rationale: Deep forged steel background. High-visibility 'Forge Orange' primary action color. Strict avoidance of SaaS blues and forbidden teals. High contrast ensures readability in warehouse/outdoor environments.

layouts.mobile_first: Sticky bottom nav on mobile with massive action buttons (+SALE, +PURCHASE) in a 2-column grid. Floating Action Button (FAB) specifically for the camera/barcode scanner.
layouts.dashboard_grid: High-density 'Bento' grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Every pixel utilized. 'Ask My Business' takes col-span-full as a commanding top banner.
layouts.spacing: Tactical spacing. Tight within data tables (p-2, p-4) but generous between distinct widget zones (gap-6, gap-8) to prevent visual overload.
layouts.surfaces: Tactical Minimalism. Flat surfaces with sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none) and 1px solid borders (border-border/60). Inner 1px highlight (box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05)). No muddy drop shadows.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid. Use border-collapse style layouts for inventory and reports. Subdued borders (border-border/40) for structure, bright solid borders (border-primary) for active states.
visual_enhancers.ai_search_box: The 'ASK MY BUSINESS' box should use the 'Crystal Glass' variant (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 with a subtle border-white/10 and high saturation). This makes it feel like an omnipresent intelligence layer floating above the physical inventory data.
visual_enhancers.status_indicators: Bright, glowing ASCII or 1px dots for ONLINE/OFFLINE/SYNCING. Needs to feel like heavy machinery control panel LEDs.

components.buttons: Heavy, pill-shaped or sharp rectangular block buttons. Active states should have an aggressive lift (-translate-y-1) and high-contrast text.
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables heavily customized: mono-spaced numbers, dense padding, alternating row subtle backgrounds for scanability.
components.cards: Cardless or raw rectangular blocks. Dashboard KPIs should feel like digital readouts, not floaty paper cards.
components.forms: Shadcn inputs but with deep backgrounds and high-contrast borders on focus (focus:ring-primary focus:border-primary).

motion.hover: Instant, sharp color transitions for utility elements. No slow fades. It must feel highly responsive.
motion.page_transitions: Slide up with subtle opacity fade.
motion.ai_search: When 'Ask My Business' is focused, dim the rest of the dashboard slightly (bg-black/50 overlay) to bring total focus to the natural language interaction.

accessibility.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA standards. All primary buttons must have high-contrast text (e.g., black text on Forge Orange).
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY. Every action button, tab, and KPI card must have a data-testid (e.g., data-testid='add-sale-button', data-testid='inventory-table-row').

image_urls.description: Black and white/moody photo of rolled steel coils. Perfect as a dramatic, dark, heavy-industry background for the PIN login screen. Apply a heavy black/50 overlay.
Rusty metal surface texture. Can be used at 2% opacity blended into the background of the app to kill digital flatness and give a tactile 'steel yard' feel.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize mobile usability: the user is a trader walking around a steel yard. Actions like '+ SALE', 'SCAN BILL', and 'INVENTORY' must be large, easily tappable with one hand.
Implement 'ASK MY BUSINESS' as a prominent sticky or fixed search bar at the top of the mobile dashboard, ensuring it is always accessible.
Do not use generic 'blue' SaaS colors. Stick strictly to the Forge Steel and Orange palette.
Ensure the camera/scanner buttons look distinct—perhaps using an icon-heavy FAB or high-contrast accent button.
When displaying inventory units (KG/MT/PCS), use the monospace font and align right for easy visual scanning of quantities.
Show explicit ONLINE/OFFLINE/SYNCING states in the top header, as warehouse internet connectivity can be spotty.
All modals (like the editable review form for handwritten bills) must have a sharp, industrial feel with clear 'Approve' or 'Needs Review' flags.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on drop-downs or sticky headers; always use a solid or highly-blurred background to ensure data beneath doesn't interfere with legibility.
Ensure all components and views are implemented via .js files since the project uses JS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where instructed.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like sharp or pill-shaped blocks with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js or .jsx equivalent.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
